initialExam.title: BSNL Junior Engineer (TTA) 2026
initialExam.description: BSNL recruits Junior Engineers (Telecom Technical Assistants) for telecom network installation, maintenance, and operations across India.
initialExam.eligibility: 3-year Engineering Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Telecom, Electronics, Electrical, Computer, IT or B.Sc (Electronics/Computer)
initialExam.qualifications: Diploma/B.Tech in relevant engineering or B.Sc (Electronics/CS)
initialExam.syllabus: General Ability: GK, Aptitude, Reasoning, English. Specialization: Telecom, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science fundamentals.
initialExam.examPattern: Online CBT: 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours. Part I: General Ability (20Q). Part II: Specialization (180Q).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Examination → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Engineer (TTA) in BSNL telecom circles for network maintenance and operations
initialExam.careerGrowth: JE TTA → SDE → DE → DGM → AGM → GM → PGM → CGM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bsnl.co.in 2. Register on BSNL recruitment portal 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Transport, Telephone allowance, LTC, Pension (NPS)

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
